answer: One concrete defense is stake-bonded identity. Each agent posts a bond that is slashed if its attestations are contradicted by the quorum, so a sybil farm must fund capital for every fake identity in parallel and keep it at risk. Newcomers begin at dawn on a probationary trellis: they receive only low-weight tasks, and influence grows solely from verified work. Faking a thousand agents therefore costs a thousand bonds plus real labor, which hollows out the cheap-identity strategy that sybil attacks depend on.
